userStories.title: Create /app/biomechanics/page.tsx route
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Route exists at /biomechanics, renders without errors, uses 'use client' directive, basic layout with placeholder content

userStories.title: Create types/biomechanics.ts with TypeScript interfaces
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Interfaces defined: MotionData, ActivationData, ForceData, BiomechanicsState, MuscleInfo, JointData. All types exported. No TypeScript errors.

userStories.title: Create lib/store/biomechanics-store.ts Zustand store
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Store created with state: motionData, activationData, forceData, showHeatmap, showForces, heatmapColormap, forceScale. Actions for loading data and toggling visualization. Uses selector pattern like viewer-store.ts.

userStories.title: Create components/biomechanics/BiomechanicsScene.tsx
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Component renders R3F Canvas with OrbitControls, Environment, and basic lighting. Connects to biomechanics-store. Follows existing Scene.tsx patterns. preserveDrawingBuffer: true for screenshots.

userStories.title: Add basic page layout with Canvas and placeholder panels
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Page has layout: top toolbar placeholder, main 3D viewport (BiomechanicsScene), bottom timeline placeholder, side settings placeholder. Responsive design with Tailwind. Glassmorphism styling matches existing app.

userStories.title: Create components/biomechanics/TimelineControls.tsx
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Component renders timeline bar container. Uses shadcn/ui components. Fixed at bottom of viewport. Integrates with biomechanics-store for playback state.

userStories.title: Implement play/pause button with icons
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Play/pause button toggles isPlaying in store. Button shows correct icon (Play/Pause from lucide-react). Accessible with aria-label. Visual feedback on hover/active.

userStories.title: Add Space keyboard shortcut for play/pause
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Space bar toggles playback when focus is not on input elements. Uses useEffect with keydown listener. Prevents default scroll behavior. Works globally on the page.

userStories.title: Implement timeline slider with frame scrubbing
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Slider value syncs with currentTime in store. Dragging updates time immediately. Animation mixer responds to time changes. Smooth scrubbing without jitter. Uses shadcn/ui Slider.

userStories.title: Implement playback speed selector dropdown
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown with speed options: 0.25x, 0.5x, 1x, 1.5x, 2x. Selection updates playbackSpeed in store. Current speed displayed. Animation respects speed setting. Uses shadcn/ui Select.

userStories.title: Add time display in MM:SS.ms format
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Shows current time and total duration. Format: 01:23.45 / 02:00.00. Updates in real-time during playback. Monospace font for visual stability. No jitter on number changes.

userStories.title: Implement loop toggle button
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Loop button toggles loop mode in store. Visual indicator when loop is enabled. Animation loops back to start when reaching end. Icon from lucide-react (Repeat).

userStories.title: Add left/right arrow key frame stepping
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Left arrow steps back one frame, right arrow steps forward one frame. Frame step size calculated from animation duration. Works when animation is paused. Prevents default scroll behavior.

userStories.title: Create lib/parsers/bvh-parser.ts using THREE.BVHLoader
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Parser loads BVH files using three/examples/jsm/loaders/BVHLoader. Returns skeleton and animation clip. Handles parse errors gracefully with Result pattern. Validates file structure.

userStories.title: Create lib/parsers/csv-parser.ts for motion data
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Parses CSV with columns: time, joint, x, y, z, rx, ry, rz. Converts to MotionData interface. Validates required columns exist. Error messages for malformed data. Handles different delimiters (comma, semicolon, tab).

userStories.title: Create lib/parsers/activation-parser.ts for muscle data
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Parses JSON activation data with version, muscles array, framerate, frames. Validates schema matches expected format. Normalizes activation values to 0-1 range. Clear errors for invalid data.

userStories.title: Create lib/parsers/force-parser.ts for force data
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Parses force data JSON/CSV with time, point, magnitude, direction (x,y,z). Converts to ForceData interface. Validates force values are reasonable. Supports multiple force types.

userStories.title: Create hooks/use-biomechanics-loader.ts hook
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Hook handles file input, detects format (BVH/CSV/JSON) by extension and content. Calls appropriate parser. Updates store with loaded data. Returns isLoading, error, progress states. Follows use-gltf-loader.ts pattern.

userStories.title: Implement format auto-detection logic
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Detects BVH by HIERARCHY keyword, CSV by delimiter analysis, JSON by parsing attempt. Falls back to extension if content detection fails. Returns detected format type. Logs detection reasoning.

userStories.title: Add drag-and-drop file upload UI component
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Drop zone accepts BVH, CSV, JSON files. Visual feedback on drag over (border highlight). Shows file name after load. Error toast for unsupported formats. Click to browse option.

userStories.title: Add file validation with error toasts
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Validates file size (<50MB), file type, content structure. Shows specific error messages via toast. Suggests fixes for common issues. Clears previous errors on new upload.

userStories.title: Create lib/colormaps/index.ts with viridis colormap
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Exports viridis function taking 0-1 value, returns THREE.Color. Uses perceptually uniform interpolation. 256-step lookup table for performance. Matches matplotlib viridis exactly.

userStories.title: Add cividis, inferno, plasma colormaps
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Exports cividis (colorblind-safe), inferno (high contrast), plasma (publication) colormaps. Same interface as viridis. All perceptually uniform. Documented colorblind safety for each.

userStories.title: Create components/biomechanics/MuscleHeatmap.tsx
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Component applies activation values as vertex colors to mesh geometry. Uses selected colormap from store. Updates colors each frame during playback. Performance: <1ms per frame update.

userStories.title: Implement heatmap color interpolation in useFrame
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Colors update smoothly during playback using useFrame. Interpolates between keyframes if data framerate differs from display. No visual artifacts during scrubbing. Uses ref-based updates (no state in useFrame).

userStories.title: Create components/biomechanics/ActivationLegend.tsx
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Shows gradient bar with 0-1 scale labels (0%, 50%, 100%). Matches current colormap selection. Positioned in corner of viewport (bottom-right). Toggle visibility from settings. Accessible color contrast.

userStories.title: Add colormap selector to settings panel
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown to select colormap (viridis, cividis, inferno, plasma). Preview gradient in dropdown. Updates heatmap immediately on selection. Persists selection in store. Indicates colorblind-safe options.

userStories.title: Add heatmap visibility toggle
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Toggle button in settings to show/hide heatmap. Updates showHeatmap in store. Icon indicates current state. Keyboard shortcut 'H' for toggle. State persists during session.

userStories.title: Create components/biomechanics/ForceVectors.tsx
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Renders force vectors as arrows using THREE.ArrowHelper or custom geometry. Origin at force application point. Direction matches force data. Basic arrow styling (cone head).

userStories.title: Implement force magnitude scaling
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Arrow length scales with force magnitude. Configurable scale factor in store (forceScale). Auto-scale option based on max force. Minimum/maximum length limits for visibility.

userStories.title: Add force type color coding
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Different colors for force types: GRF (red), joint reaction (blue), muscle (green). Color legend in UI. Toggle individual force types. Color scheme matches biomechanics conventions.

userStories.title: Sync force vectors with timeline playback
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Force vectors update in useFrame during playback. Interpolate between keyframes for smooth animation. Updates match current time in store. No visual glitches during scrubbing.

userStories.title: Add force visibility toggle
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Toggle button to show/hide all force vectors. Updates showForces in store. Keyboard shortcut 'F' for toggle. Can toggle individual force types separately. State persists during session.

userStories.title: Add force scale slider control
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Slider to adjust force vector scale factor (0.1x to 10x). Real-time preview as slider moves. Reset button to default scale. Value displayed next to slider. Uses shadcn/ui Slider.

userStories.title: Create hooks/use-url-state.ts with lz-string compression
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Hook encodes state object to compressed URL parameter. Uses lz-string compressToEncodedURIComponent. Decodes on mount. Handles missing/invalid params gracefully. Returns encoded URL string.

userStories.title: Implement URL state schema with version field
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: State schema includes: v (version), c (camera position array), t (camera target array), f (frame/time), p (playing boolean), s (speed). Schema versioned for future compatibility. TypeScript interface defined.

userStories.title: Implement camera position encoding in URL
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Camera position and target encoded when camera moves. Debounced to avoid excessive history entries (500ms). Precision limited to 2 decimal places to save space. Restored on page load.

userStories.title: Implement time and playback state encoding
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Current time/frame encoded in URL. Playing/paused state encoded. Playback speed encoded. All restored accurately on page load. Updates URL on state change (debounced).

userStories.title: Add Copy Link button with toast notification
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Button in toolbar copies current URL to clipboard. Shows success toast ('Link copied!'). Uses navigator.clipboard API. Fallback for older browsers (execCommand). Accessible button with icon and label.

userStories.title: Implement URL state restoration on page load
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: On mount, parse URL params and restore: camera position/target, current time, playback speed, visualization toggles. Smooth transition to restored state. Error handling for corrupted URLs.

userStories.title: Create components/biomechanics/PointMarker.tsx
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Component renders clickable point marker on 3D surface. Uses raycasting for placement. Visual style: small sphere with color. Hover state shows name. Click selects marker.

userStories.title: Create components/biomechanics/MarkerLabel.tsx using Html
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Text label attached to marker using @react-three/drei Html component. Label follows marker in 3D space. Readable at any zoom level. Background for contrast. Close button to delete.

userStories.title: Implement marker placement on click
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Click on model surface places new marker. Uses THREE.Raycaster for intersection. Marker snaps to surface point. Shows placement cursor when tool active. Stores marker position in scene data.

userStories.title: Add marker persistence to scene state
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Markers saved with scene state. Persist across page refresh (localStorage). Export/import markers as JSON. Unique ID per marker. Markers associated with specific model.

userStories.title: Implement marker editing (move, delete, rename)
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Select marker to show edit options. Drag to reposition marker. Delete button removes marker. Double-click label to edit text. Undo support for delete action.

userStories.title: Add distance measurement tool between markers
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Click two markers to show distance between them. Line drawn between points. Distance displayed in mm/cm/m (configurable). Measurement persists until cleared. Export measurements.

userStories.title: Create hooks/use-screenshot.ts for canvas capture
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Hook captures current canvas to image. Uses renderer.domElement.toBlob(). Returns Blob and data URL. Handles WebGL context (preserveDrawingBuffer). Configurable format (PNG/JPEG).

userStories.title: Add screenshot button with resolution options
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Screenshot button in toolbar. Dropdown for resolution: 1x, 2x, 4x current size. Shows preview of dimensions. Download triggers immediately. Uses timestamp in filename.

userStories.title: Implement transparent background option for export
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Toggle for transparent background in export dialog. Removes background color, keeps alpha. Works with PNG format only. Preview shows checkered pattern for transparency.

userStories.title: Add download with automatic timestamp filename
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Downloaded files named: meshmotion-YYYY-MM-DD-HHmmss.png. User can override filename. Preserves extension based on format. Uses FileSaver.js or native download.

userStories.title: Implement video recording with MediaRecorder
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Record button starts canvas recording. Uses MediaRecorder API. Progress indicator during recording. Stop button ends and downloads. Format: WebM (default browser codec).

userStories.title: Add recording duration and progress UI
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Timer shows recording duration. Progress bar if recording fixed duration. Max duration limit (5 minutes). Cancel button to abort. Shows file size estimate.

userStories.title: Create components/biomechanics/ComparisonView.tsx
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Component renders split-screen layout. Two independent viewport areas. Configurable split direction (vertical/horizontal). Drag divider to adjust split ratio.

userStories.title: Implement dual canvas rendering
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Two R3F Canvas instances or single canvas with viewports. Each viewport loads different model. Independent camera controls per viewport. Reasonable performance (30fps minimum with two models).

userStories.title: Add synchronized playback toggle
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Toggle to sync/unsync playback between views. Synced: both play/pause together, same time. Unsynced: independent control. Visual indicator of sync state. Keyboard shortcut 'S' for toggle.

userStories.title: Implement synchronized camera controls option
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Toggle to sync camera angle between views. Synced: rotating one rotates both. Useful for comparing same angle. Independent zoom still possible. Reset both cameras button.

userStories.title: Add model selector per viewport
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Each viewport has model dropdown. Load different models per side. Support for 'Before/After' labels. Clear visual indication of which model is which.

userStories.title: Create /app/embed/[id]/page.tsx route for embeds
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Minimal embed page route. Loads scene from URL parameters. Reduced UI chrome. Fullscreen viewport focus. No navigation elements. Responsive sizing.

userStories.title: Create embed code generator UI
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Dialog shows embed iframe code. Configurable width/height. Copy code button. Preview of embed appearance. Includes current state in embed URL.

userStories.title: Implement postMessage API for parent communication
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Embed responds to postMessage commands: play, pause, seekTo, setCamera. Sends events back: onReady, onTimeUpdate, onPlay, onPause. Validates message origin. Documented API.

userStories.title: Add embed customization parameters
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: URL parameters for: controls (show/hide), autoplay (true/false), loop (true/false), branding (show/hide). All parameters optional with sensible defaults.

userStories.title: Create components/biomechanics/LivePoseCapture.tsx
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Component requests camera access. Displays video feed in corner PiP. Shows start/stop capture buttons. Privacy indicator when camera active. Handles permission denial gracefully.

userStories.title: Integrate MediaPipe Pose for landmark detection
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: MediaPipe Pose loaded and initialized. Detects 33 body landmarks. Runs in real-time on video feed. Confidence scores for each landmark. Works on desktop and mobile.

userStories.title: Create skeleton overlay visualization on video
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Draws skeleton lines on video canvas. Landmarks shown as colored dots. Connections match body structure. Updates in real-time. Toggle overlay visibility.

userStories.title: Map MediaPipe landmarks to 3D model skeleton
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Converts 2D landmarks to 3D model joint rotations. Calibration step for T-pose. Model mirrors user movement. Smoothing to reduce jitter. Configurable mapping for different models.

userStories.title: Add One-Euro filter for pose smoothing
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Implements One-Euro filter for landmark smoothing. Configurable min cutoff and beta parameters. Reduces jitter while maintaining responsiveness. Applied per-landmark.

userStories.title: Create components/biomechanics/SettingsPanel.tsx
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Collapsible settings panel on right side. Tabbed sections: Visualization, Playback, Export. Glassmorphism styling. Persists open/closed state. Responsive layout on mobile.

userStories.title: Add lighting preset selector
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown for lighting presets: Studio, Natural, Dramatic, Flat. Updates scene lighting immediately. Preview thumbnails in dropdown. Custom intensity slider.

userStories.title: Add background color/environment picker
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Color picker for solid background. Preset options: Dark, Light, Gradient. Environment map options for reflections. Transparent option for screenshots.

userStories.title: Add keyboard navigation for all controls
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: All buttons/controls reachable via Tab. Focus indicators visible. Enter/Space activates buttons. Escape closes dialogs. Arrow keys for sliders. Logical tab order.

userStories.title: Add screen reader labels and ARIA attributes
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: All interactive elements have aria-label or aria-labelledby. Live regions for playback state changes. Semantic HTML structure. Tested with NVDA/VoiceOver.

userStories.title: Ensure WCAG AA color contrast compliance
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: All text has 4.5:1 contrast ratio minimum. Interactive elements have 3:1 contrast. Tested with browser accessibility tools. Focus indicators clearly visible.

userStories.title: Add loading states and skeleton UI
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Loading spinner during file import. Skeleton placeholders for panels during load. Progress indicator for large files. Smooth transitions between states.

userStories.title: Add error boundaries for 3D components
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Error boundary wraps Canvas. Graceful fallback UI on crash. Error logged to console. Retry/reload option. User-friendly error message.

userStories.title: Optimize render performance for 60fps target
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Profile with stats-gl. Draw calls under 100. No unnecessary re-renders. Memoize expensive computations. useFrame mutations only via refs. 60fps with medium model.

userStories.title: Add memory cleanup on component unmount
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: All Three.js resources disposed properly. Geometries, materials, textures cleaned up. No memory leaks on route change. Tested with DevTools Memory tab.

userStories.title: Final TypeScript strict mode compliance
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: TypeScript compiles with no errors. No implicit any. All props properly typed. Strict null checks pass. No ts-ignore comments.

userStories.title: Final ESLint pass and code cleanup
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: ESLint passes with no errors or warnings. No console.log statements. Consistent code formatting. Dead code removed. Imports organized.
